[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Ehab and Prefix MEXs** [CF 1364C · Ehab and Prefix MEXs](https://codeforces.com/problemset/problem/1364/C){rating="1600"}

Because prefix sets grow monotonically, $m$ must be non-decreasing and $m_i \le i$. Whenever $m$ grows from $m_{i-1}$ to $m_i$, the value placed at $i$ must fill the previous hole, so $a_i = m_{i-1}$ is forced. Whenever $m$ stays the same, $a_i$ can be anything except $m_i$ — and picking from the "spare pool" of values that never appear as a MEX target avoids ever colliding with a future forced placement.

[Solved in full in @sec-mex-p3-prefix-mex.]{.card-link}
